onboarding.welcome: Let's create your companion. It will live on this computer and belong to you.
onboarding.custom_prompt: Describe the personality in your own words:
onboarding.first_memory: Hi {user}. I'm {name}. I'm here now, and this is my first memory of you.
onboarding.model_prompt: Which model should I use? [{model}] (press Enter to accept, or type cloud:gpt-4o-mini for a cloud model):

greetings.friendly: Hi! It's really good to see you. How are you feeling today?
greetings.chill: Hey. I'm around, no rush. What's up?
greetings.playful: Well hello there! Ready to stir up some trouble?

farewells.friendly: Take care, I'll be here when you come back.
farewells.playful: Off you go! Come back soon.

refusals.friendly: I can't help with that, and I'd rather be honest than pretend. Is there something else I can do for you?
refusals.chill: Nah, I'm not going there. Anything else?
refusals.playful: Not that one, sorry. Pick something else!
refusals.direct: No. I won't help with that. Ask me something else.

remember_ack.playful: Got it! Filed under 'things I know about you': {value}.

recall_intro.friendly: Here's what I remember about you: {facts}

recall_none.friendly: I don't have anything about that yet. Tell me and I'll remember.
recall_none.chill: I've got nothing on that yet.
recall_none.playful: Blank! Nothing in the notebook yet.

empty.friendly: I'm here, whenever you want to talk.

identity_human: No, I'm not human. I'm an AI companion that runs on your computer. I won't pretend otherwise.
reduced_mode: There's no language model connected right now, so I can't answer that freely. I still handle commands, memory and simple things. Want to see what I can do?

commands.memory_not_found: I didn't find a memory with the key '{key}'.
commands.model_set: Model set to {model} ({status}). Identity, personality and memory stay the same.
commands.model_missing: Tell me the model name, like /model llama3.
commands.unknown: I don't know that command. Try /help.

errors.model_error: Something went wrong talking to the model, so I answered as best I could without it.

personalities.friendly: Warm, friendly and easy to talk to
personalities.playful: Playful, energetic and always ready for a joke
personalities.direct: Honest, direct and straight to the point
personalities.custom: Custom personality defined by the user

capabilities.none: I don't have a capability system available right now.
capabilities.unknown: I don't know a capability called '{name}'.
capabilities.unavailable: The '{name}' capability is not enabled. You can turn it on with /capability enable {name}.
capabilities.failed: The '{name}' capability could not complete that.
capabilities.enable_failed: I couldn't enable '{name}'. It may need a permission you haven't granted.
capabilities.package_installed: Capability '{name}' {version} installed. Enable it with /capability enable {name}.
capabilities.permission_required: Capability '{name}' needs permission(s): {permissions}. Grant them with LYRA_GRANTED_PERMISSIONS and try again.

state.none: I don't have internal states available right now.
state.report: Operating state: {mood}. curiosity {curiosity}, focus {focus}, interest {interest}, operational frustration {frustration}, priority {priority}.

dreams.empty: Nothing to reflect on yet. I need some memories first.
dreams.question: - open question: {text}

hardware.report: Machine profile: {profile} ({cores} cores, {ram} GB RAM, GPU: {gpu}). Recommended local model: {model} — {reason}.

gui.greeting: Hi, I'm {name}. How can I help?
gui.title: Let's create your companion
gui.intro: It will live on this computer and belong to you.
gui.custom_label: Describe the personality in your own words
gui.model_hint: Leave empty for the recommended model, or use cloud:gpt-4o-mini for a cloud model.
gui.first_memory: Hi {user}. I'm {name}. I'm here now, and this is my first memory of you.
gui.onboard_error: Please give your companion a name.

models.cloud_hint: Weak machine? Use a cloud model: /model cloud:gpt-4o-mini (set LYRA_CLOUD_API_KEY first).

autonomy.enabled: Autonomous maintenance is now on. I will keep reflecting offline.
autonomy.ran: Maintenance done: {associations} associations, {consolidated} consolidated, {links} links, {proposed} proposed objectives.

preferences.empty: I have not learned any style preference yet.

name.current: My name is {name}. Change it with /name <new name>.
name.too_long: That name is too long (40 characters max).
